about: The reconciliation of specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md against the rendered page of the scanned PDF (kb/Work PB4850). `book_pages` is the transcription's page count and `pages_swept` the pages compared: every one of the 976 pages was compared by the batch passes of 2026-11-06 (claims, an adversarial verify and a second opinion; a box pass over every page). A page with no claim was found to agree with its transcription. Each claim carries its decision: APPLIED (with the edit, read against the rendered page first), REFUTED, ALREADY (repaired before), FORMAT (a general format, decided by figures-1985), BOX (a level-2 box, marked from the box pass), FIGURE (an illustration) or KEPT. A sweep is a sibling of an applied claim found on the page or across the file. Each box carries MARKED (and the number of blocks marked with a pair of ║), FORMAT or NOT MARKED. verify_publishable.py --edition 1985 holds the transcription to this ledger. SECOND PASS (kb/Work PB6051, owner 2026-11-22): a second independent pass over all 976 pages by agents that did not see the first pass's claims (236 claims, each with its own adversarial verdict: 167 confirmed, 69 refuted); its claims carry `pass: 2` and the id of their compare file. The headings of the whole standard were derived afresh from the printed Table of Contents (kb/Work PB6057; scripts/spec/heading_levels.py): each is a sweep `heading-levels(PB6057)` or an edit of the claim that named it. THIRD PASS (kb/Work PB6051, decision PB6091, owner 2026-11-22): a third independent pass over all 976 pages (25 claims, each with its own adversarial verdict: 7 confirmed, 18 refuted); its claims carry `pass: 3`. All 7 confirmed claims are APPLIED, five of the refuted ones are decided by the title rule of kb/Work PB6095 (APPLIED with the claim's batch still REFUTED), and the siblings of the repairs are sweeps (`format-titles(PB6095)`, `box-labels(PB6051 p354-1)`, `brace-column(PB6051 p213-1)`).
